custody_model: Exchange-hosted staking service provided by Bitvavo B.V. Current first-party materials state that Bitvavo may stake supported digital assets in third-party proof-of-stake protocols or networks. Flex Staking keeps assets available to trade or withdraw, while Fixed Staking locks selected assets for a defined period. These operational mechanics do not establish one universal legal-title or insolvency-treatment model.
yield_source: Rewards are associated with supported proof-of-stake protocols or networks. Bitvavo sets displayed reward rates and may account for network and service fees in those rates.
risk_notes: Risks include protocol and validator risk, slashing, smart-contract vulnerabilities where applicable, market volatility, regulatory change and Fixed Staking lock-up/liquidity constraints. Bitvavo states the Staking service is currently outside MiCA regulation.

custody_model: Lending service provided by Bitvavo Custody B.V. First-party materials state eligible digital assets may be lent to professional parties that support platform liquidity and may also be lent to other users for margin trading. Assets generally remain tradable or withdrawable, subject to program conditions. Reviewed public material does not establish one universal legal-title, segregation or insolvency-treatment rule.
yield_source: Rewards arise from making eligible assets available through Bitvavo Custody B.V. to professional liquidity counterparties and potentially margin-trading users. Rates vary by asset and are calculated daily and paid weekly.
risk_notes: Risks include centralized counterparty, borrower and liquidity exposure, variable reward rates, market risk and jurisdictional/regulatory risk. Bitvavo states Lending is currently outside MiCA regulation and that some regulated-service safeguards may not apply.

custody_model: Fixed-term centralized reward product managed inside the Coinmetro account. The launch announcement states BTC is held for the selected 3, 6, 12 or 24 month term and that the full BTC balance is returned at term end. Reviewed public material does not establish legal-title transfer, segregation, trust treatment, insurance or insolvency treatment, so CYA leaves those unresolved.
yield_source: Coinmetro states rewards are generated and distributed through its internal infrastructure without external lending platforms, third-party protocols, wrapped assets or synthetic tokens. The reviewed source does not disclose the underlying economic source of that internal reward generation.
risk_notes: Risks include centralized-platform and solvency exposure, fixed-term illiquidity, reward forfeiture on early exit, Bitcoin market volatility and uncertainty about the undisclosed underlying economic source of rewards. The term-end return statement is a product promise rather than an independent principal guarantee.
